name: Seraphim Slum
source:
Ezekiel has moved into the slums. She finds herself enamored with its inhabitants: three girls, in particular.

Befriend a girl, fall in love, and break them by awakening them. Teach them to go against their mental constraints, to fight back against their oppressors. Push them over the edge.

It's not a matter of if they fall... but how they fall.

[From [url=https://rosesrot.itch.io/seraphim-slum]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
以西结已经搬进了贫民窟。她发现自己迷上了这里的居民：尤其是三个女孩。

与女孩交朋友，坠入爱河，并通过唤醒她们来打破她们。教导他们反抗精神束缚，反击压迫者。将它们推到边缘。

问题不在于他们是否跌倒……而在于他们如何跌倒。

[来自[url=https://rosesrot.itch.io/seraphim-slum]itch.io[/url]]
